title: Gobena wins maiden Major – Abbott World Marathon Majors
claims: The race report says the men's race only opened up at the 37 km mark as the lead group headed into the Royal Botanic Gardens.
The report describes the lead group heading into the final downhill section before Addisu Gobena pulled clear.
The report says David Weir signalled his intentions by racing into a lead on the Harbour Bridge incline.
The report says Daniel Romanchuk took control after the 10 km mark through the elevation into Oxford Street.
The report says Peres Jepchirchir and Irine Cheptai took control after the 30 km mark, and Jepchirchir dropped Cheptai from 35 km.
The report says Manuela Schär put time into Eden Rainbow-Cooper just before the elevated section into Driver Avenue.
